ASSERT.stands_in_for: the comparator's output going from open to its highest stated saturation voltage in a step; the real output takes a finite time, which only lengthens this

CGATE.stands_in_for: the gate capacitor at the low end of its tolerance and retaining only the declared fraction of that under bias, which is the case that slews fastest

RSER.stands_in_for: the series element at the low end of its tolerance

RUP.stands_in_for: the gate pull-up at the low end of its tolerance

VBUS.stands_in_for: the source at the top of the Type-C range, which is the case that moves the gate furthest and so fastest

description: the input switch's gate from the instant the detector asserts, watched for the time the design requires the switch to take
name: input_switch_gate_slew_on_acceptance
